headline: DeepSeek surges past OpenAI as top two hold 40.2%
summary: DeepSeek jumped 1.0 percentage point overnight to claim 22.5% of tokens, while OpenAI dropped 8.0 points to 17.6%—a dramatic reversal that reshuffles the podium. The top four providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Tencent, Zhipu AI) now command 65.6% of the market. Anthropic bounced back with a 1.7-point daily gain, and two new Anthropic models entered the rankings at positions 41 and 51.
highlights: Anthropic: 3.6% (+1.7% today) with two new entrants
